verses.geez:
ወእምድኅረ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ አመ ፡ ማአረረ ፡ ስርናይ ፡ ኀወጻ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ለብእሲቱ ፡ ወአምጽኣ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ማሕሥአ ፡ ጠሊ
                  ፡ ወይቤ ፡ እባእ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ብእሲትየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽርሕ ፡ ወከልኦ ፡ አቡሃ ፡ በዊአ ፡ ኀቤሃ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass after a time, in the days of wheat harvest, that Sampson visited his wife with a kid, and said, I will go in to my wife even into the chamber: but her father did not suffer him to go in.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass after a time, in the days of wheat harvest, that Sampson visited his wife with a kid, and said, I will go in to my wife even into the chamber: but her father did not suffer him to go in.
translations.kjv: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.
translations.ron: Peste câteva zile, în timpul seceratului grâului, a venit Samson să se vadă cu femeia sa, aducând cu sine un ied. Iar când a zis: "Mă duc la femeia mea în odaia de dormit", tatăl ei nu l-a lăsat să intre.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ አቡሃ ፡ እስመ ፡ ትቤ ፡ ጸላእክዋ ፡ ወሀብክዎ ፡ ለካልእከ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ [ነያ ፡] እኅታ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትንእሳ
                  ፡ ወትሤንያ ፡ ወትኩንከ ፡ ህየንቴሃ ።
verses.translation: And her father spoke, saying, I said that thou didst surely hate her, and I gave her to one of thy friends: is not her younger sister better than she? let her be to thee instead of her.

translations.lxx: And her father spoke, saying, I said that thou didst surely hate her, and I gave her to one of thy friends: is not her younger sister better than she? let her be to thee instead of her.
translations.kjv: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.
translations.ron: Şi a zis tatăl ei: "Eu am socotit că ai urât-o şi am măritat-o cu un prieten al tău; iată sora ei mai mică e mai frumoasă decât ea; să fie aceasta în locul aceleia".

verses.geez: ወይቤ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ አነ ፡ ምዕረ ፡ እምነ ፡ አሎፍል ፡ እስመ ፡ አነ ፡ እገብር ፡ እኪተ ፡ ምስሌክሙ ።
verses.translation: And Sampson said to them, Even for once am I guiltless with regard to the Philistines, in that I do mischief among them.

translations.lxx: And Sampson said to them, Even for once am I guiltless with regard to the Philistines, in that I do mischief among them.
translations.kjv: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.
translations.ron: Samson însă le-a zis: "De acum eu voi fi drept înaintea Filistenilor, dacă mă voi apuca să le fac rău".

verses.geez:
ወሖረ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ወአኀዘ ፡ ሠለስተ ፡ ምእተ ፡ ቈናጽለ ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ መኃትወ ፡ ወአሰረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዝናቢሆሙ ፡
                  ወወደየ ፡ አሐተ ፡ ማኅቶተ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ አዝናቢሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And Sampson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took torches, and turned tail to tail, and put a torch between two tails, and fastened it.

translations.lxx: And Sampson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took torches, and turned tail to tail, and put a torch between two tails, and fastened it.
translations.kjv: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.
translations.ron: Apoi Samson s-a dus şi a prins trei sute de vulpi, a luat făclii, a legat câte două vulpi de coadă şi intre ele câte o făclie;

verses.geez:
ወአኅተወ ፡ እሳተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መኃትው ፡ ወፈነዎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ክልስስታት ፡ ዘአሎፍል ፡ ወአውዐዩ ፡ ሠዊተ ፡
                  ወክምረ ፡ ዘተዐፅደ ፡ ወዘይቀውም ፡ ወዘውጡሕ ፡ ወአዕጻዳተ ፡ ወይን ፡ ወዘዘይት ።
verses.translation: And he set fire to the torches, and sent the foxes into the corn of the Philistines; and every thing was burnt from the threshing floor to the standing corn, and even to the vineyard and olives.

translations.lxx: And he set fire to the torches, and sent the foxes into the corn of the Philistines; and every thing was burnt from the threshing floor to the standing corn, and even to the vineyard and olives.
translations.kjv: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.
translations.ron: După aceea a aprins făcliile şi a dat drumul vulpilor prin grânele Filistenilor şi a aprins şi clăile şi grâul nesecerat, viile şi livezile de măslini.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሉ ፡ አሎፍል ፡ መኑ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ሐሙሁ ፡ ለተምናታዊ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሄድዎ ፡ ብእሲቶ
                  ፡ ወወሀብዋ ፡ ለካልኡ ፡ ወዐርጉ ፡ አሎፍል ፡ ወአውዐዩ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አቡሃ ፡ ወኪያሃኒ ፡ ወአቡሃኒ ፡ በእሳት ።
verses.translation: And the Philistines said, Who has done these things? and they said, Sampson the son-in-law of the Thamnite, because he has taken his wife, and given her to one of his friends; and the Philistines went up, and burnt her and her father's house with fire.

translations.lxx: And the Philistines said, Who has done these things? and they said, Sampson the son-in-law of the Thamnite, because he has taken his wife, and given her to one of his friends; and the Philistines went up, and burnt her and her father's house with fire.
translations.kjv: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.
translations.ron: Şi ziceau Filistenii: "Cine oare a făcut aceasta?" Şi li s-a spus: "Samson, ginerele Timneanului, căci acesta i-a luat femeia şi a dat-o după un prieten al lui". Atunci Filistenii s-au dus şi au ars-o cu foc şi pe ea şi casa tatălui ei.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ እመሰ ፡ ገበርክሙ ፡ [ዘንተ ፡] ኢይፈቅድ ፤ በቀልየሰ ፡ እምነ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ወለኵልክሙ ፡
                  እምረሰይኩ ።
verses.translation: And Sampson said to them, Though ye may have dealt thus with her, verily I will be avenged of you, and afterwards I will cease.

translations.lxx: And Sampson said to them, Though ye may have dealt thus with her, verily I will be avenged of you, and afterwards I will cease.
translations.kjv: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.
translations.ron: Dar Samson le-a zis: "Cu toate că aţi făcut aceasta, eu tot am să mă răzbun pe voi şi numai atunci am să mă liniştesc".

verses.geez:
ወዘበጦሙ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ውስተ ፡ አቍያጸ ፡ እገሪሆሙ ፡ ወኮነ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ቀትል ፡ ወወረደ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ወነበረ ፡ ውስተ
                  ፡ ፈለግ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በአተ ፡ ኤጣም ።
verses.translation: And he smote them leg on thigh with a great overthrow; and went down and dwelt in a cave of the rock Etam.

translations.lxx: And he smote them leg on thigh with a great overthrow; and went down and dwelt in a cave of the rock Etam.
translations.kjv: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.
translations.ron: Şi le-a sfărâmat fluierele picioarelor şi şoldurile şi apoi s-a dus şi a şezut în peştera de la stânca Etam.

verses.geez: ወዐርጉ ፡ አሎፍል ፡ ወኀደሩ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወተዐዝሩ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሌ[ሒ] ።
verses.translation: And the Philistines went up, and encamped in Juda, and spread themselves abroad in Lechi.

translations.lxx: And the Philistines went up, and encamped in Juda, and spread themselves abroad in Lechi.
translations.kjv: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
translations.ron: Filistenii însă s-au dus şi şi-au aşezat tabăra în Iuda şi s-au întins până la Lehi.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ዐረግሙ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ አሎፍል ፡ ከመ ፡ ንእስሮ ፡ ለሶምሶን
                  ፡ ዐረግነ ፡ ወንግበሮ ፡ በከመ ፡ ገብረነ ።
verses.translation: And the men of Juda said, Why are ye come up against us? and the Philistines said, We are come up to bind Sampson, and to do to him as he has done to us.

translations.lxx: And the men of Juda said, Why are ye come up against us? and the Philistines said, We are come up to bind Sampson, and to do to him as he has done to us.
translations.kjv: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.
translations.ron: Iar locuitorii lui Iuda au zis: "Pentru ce aţi ieşit voi asupra noastră?" Şi ei au zis: "Am venit să legăm pe Samson, ca să facem cu el cum a făcut şi el cu noi".

verses.geez:
ወወረዱ ፡ ሠላሳ ፡ ምእት ፡ ብእሲ ፡ እምነ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ኀበ ፡ በአተ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ዘኤጣም ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለሶምሶን ፡
                  ኢታአምርኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ አሎፍል ፡ ይኴንኑነ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ በከመ ፡ ገብሩ ፡
                  ላዕሌክሙ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ገበርኩ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the three thousand men of Juda went down to the hole of the rock Etam, and they said to Sampson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines rule over us? and what is this that thou hast done to us? and Sampson said to them, As they did to me, so have I done to them.

translations.lxx: And the three thousand men of Juda went down to the hole of the rock Etam, and they said to Sampson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines rule over us? and what is this that thou hast done to us? and Sampson said to them, As they did to me, so have I done to them.
translations.kjv: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.
translations.ron: Atunci s-au dus trei mii de oameni din Iuda la peştera de la stânca Etam şi au zis către Samson: "Nu ştii tu, oare, că Filistenii domnesc peste noi? De ce ne-ai făcut tu una ca asta?" El însă a zis: "Cum s-au purtat ei cu mine, aşa m-am purtat şi eu cu ei".

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንእስርከ ፡ ወረድነ ፡ ወናግብእከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሆሙ ፡ ለአሎፍል ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ መሐሉ ፡
                  ሊተ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትቅትሉኒ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ወአግብኡኒ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ወአንትሙሰ ፡ ኢትትራከቡ ፡ ምስሌየ ።
verses.translation: And they said to him, We are come down to bind thee to deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines: and Sampson said to them, Swear to me that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.

translations.lxx: And they said to him, We are come down to bind thee to deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines: and Sampson said to them, Swear to me that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.
translations.kjv: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.
translations.ron: I-au zis lui: "Noi am venit să te legăm, ca să te dăm în mâinile Filistenilor". Atunci Samson le-a zis: "Juraţi-vă mie că nu mă veţi ucide!"

verses.geez:
ወመሐሉ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዳእሙ ፡ ነአስረከ ፡ በማእስር ፡ ወናገብአከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሆሙ ፡ ወቀቲለሰ ፡
                  ኢንቀትለከ ፡ ወአሰርዎ ፡ በክልኤቱ ፡ መፃምድ ፡ ሐደስት ፡ ወአውፅአዎ ፡ እምነ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ኰኵሕ ።
verses.translation: And they spoke to him, saying, Nay, but we will only bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand, and will by no means slay thee: and they bound him with two new ropes, and brought him from that rock.

translations.lxx: And they spoke to him, saying, Nay, but we will only bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand, and will by no means slay thee: and they bound him with two new ropes, and brought him from that rock.
translations.kjv: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.
translations.ron: Şi ei au răspuns: "Nu, noi numai te vom lega şi te vom da în mâinile lor, dar de omorât nu te vom omorî". Şi l-au legat cu două funii noi şi l-au dus din peşteră.

verses.geez:
ወበጽሐ ፡ እስከነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ዐጽመ ፡ መንከስ ፡ ወወውዑ ፡ አሎፍል ፡ ወተቀበልዎ ፡ ወሮጹ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ወመጽአ ፡ ላዕሌሁ
                  ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኮኑ ፡ እልክቱ ፡ መፃምድ ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መዝራእቱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ያጼኑ ፡ እሳተ ፡
                  ኀሠር ፡ ወተፈትሐ ፡ ማኅሜሁ ፡ እምነ ፡ መዝራእቱ ።
verses.translation: And they came to Lechi: and the Philistines shouted, and ran to meet him: and the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him, and the ropes that were upon his arms became as tow which is burnt with fire; and his bonds were consumed from off his hands.

translations.lxx: And they came to Lechi: and the Philistines shouted, and ran to meet him: and the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him, and the ropes that were upon his arms became as tow which is burnt with fire; and his bonds were consumed from off his hands.
translations.kjv: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.
translations.ron: Dar când s-a apropiat el de Lehi, Filistenii l-au întâmpinat cu strigăte. Atunci s-a coborât peste el Duhul Domnului şi funiile care erau peste mâinile lui s-au făcut ca nişte câlţi arşi de foc şi au căzut legăturile de pe mâinile lui.

verses.geez:
ወረከበ ፡ ዐጽመ ፡ መንከስ ፡ ዘአድግ ፡ ግዱፈ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ ወአትሐተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወተመጠዋ ፡ ወቀተለ ፡ ባቲ ፡
                  ዐሠርተ ፡ ምእተ ፡ ብእሴ ።
verses.translation: And he found the jaw-bone of an ass that had been cast away, and he put forth his hand and took it, and smote with it a thousand men.

translations.lxx: And he found the jaw-bone of an ass that had been cast away, and he put forth his hand and took it, and smote with it a thousand men.
translations.kjv: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
translations.ron: Iar el găsind o falcă sănătoasă de asin, şi-a întins mâna, a luat-o şi a ucis cu ea o mie de oameni.

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ በዐጽመ ፡ መንከሰ ፡ አድግ ፡ ደምስሶ ፡ ደምሰስክዎሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ በዐጽመ ፡ መንከሰ ፡ አድግ ፡
                  ቀተልኩ ፡ ዐሠርተ ፡ ምእተ ፡ ብእሴ ።
verses.translation: And Sampson said, With the jaw-bone of an ass I have utterly destroyed them, for with the jaw-bone of an ass I have smitten a thousand men.

translations.lxx: And Sampson said, With the jaw-bone of an ass I have utterly destroyed them, for with the jaw-bone of an ass I have smitten a thousand men.
translations.kjv: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.
translations.ron: Apoi a zis Samson: "Cu o falcă de măgar o ceată, două cete am stins, Cu o falcă de măgar o mie de oameni am ucis".

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡ አኅለቀ ፡ ነቢበ ፡ ገደፋ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ዐጽመ ፡ መንከስ ፡ እምነ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወሰመዮ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡
                  መካን ፡ ቀትለ ፡ ዐጽመ ፡ መንከስ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when he ceased speaking, that he cast the jaw-bone out of his hand; and he called that place the Lifting of the jaw-bone.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass when he ceased speaking, that he cast the jaw-bone out of his hand; and he called that place the Lifting of the jaw-bone.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.
translations.ron: Şi zicând acestea, a aruncat falca din mâini şi a numit locul acela Ramat-Lehi.

verses.geez:
ወጸምአ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ወጸርኀ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይቤ ፡ አንተ ፡ አግባእከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ገብርከ ፡ ዛተ ፡
                  ሕይወተ ፡ ዐባየ ፡ ወይእዜሰ ፡ እመውት ፡ በጽምእ ፡ ወእወድቅ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሆሙ ፡ ለቈላፍያን ።
verses.translation: And he was very thirsty, and wept before the Lord, and said, Thou hast been well pleased to grant this great deliverance by the hand of thy servant, and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

translations.lxx: And he was very thirsty, and wept before the Lord, and said, Thou hast been well pleased to grant this great deliverance by the hand of thy servant, and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?
translations.kjv: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?
translations.ron: Simţind însă sete mare, a strigat către Domnul şi a zis: "Tu ai făcut prin mâna robului Tău această mare izbăvire; iar acum eu mor de sete şi voi cădea în mâinile celor netăiaţi împrejur".

verses.geez:
ወአርኀወ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ንቅዐታ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ዐጽመ ፡ መንከስ ፡ ወወፅአ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ማይ ፡ ወሰትየ ፡ ወገብአት ፡
                  ነፍሱ ፡ ወአዕረፈ ፡ በበይነ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ተሰምየ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ነቅዐ ፡ ዐጽመ ፡ መንከስ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዮም ።
verses.translation: And God broke open a hollow place in the jaw, and there came thence water, and he drank; and his spirit returned and he revived: therefore the name of the fountain was called ‘The well of the invoker,’ which is in Lechi, until this day.

translations.lxx: And God broke open a hollow place in the jaw, and there came thence water, and he drank; and his spirit returned and he revived: therefore the name of the fountain was called ‘The well of the invoker,’ which is in Lechi, until this day.
translations.kjv: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof Enhakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.
translations.ron: Atunci a deschis Domnul o crăpătură într-o stâncă din Lehi şi a curs din ea apă. Şi a băut Samson şi şi-a astâmpărat setea şi duhul lui s-a înviorat. De aceea s-a şi numit locul acela: "Izvorul celui ce strigă", care este în Lehi până în ziua de astăzi.

verses.geez: ወኰነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ በመዋዕለ ፡ አሎፍል ፡ ፳ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

translations.lxx: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.
translations.kjv: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.
translations.ron: Şi a fost el judecător în Israel pe vremea Filistenilor douăzeci de ani.
